section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Perceived Sociocultural Influences on Body Image and Body Change Questionnaire (McCabe & Ricciardelli, 2001), noting it originally contains 62 items across mother, father, friends, and media scales. In the current study, parent items were replaced by partner items (skippable if not applicable) and a 14-item subset was administered, with item scores averaged for partner, friends, and media pressures; no sample characteristics, administration method, or statistical results are reported here.
section_summary.evidence_source: "This questionnaire comprises 62 items assessing perceived appearance pressures from one's mother (13 items), father (13 items), friends (26 items), and media (10 items)." "In this study, questions concerning one's parents were replaced with questions concerning one's romantic partner, which could be skipped if not applicable. To reduce participant burden, 14 items were administered... Item scores were averaged for perceived appearance pressures from one's partner, friends, and media."
